title: PonderThyOrb
description: A mod that adds an orb to ponder!
body:
# Ponder adds many magical decorations fit for a wizard tower.
![Interior of a Wizard Tower](https://files.catbox.moe/jfzfrs.png)
- **The Pondering Orb!** _[works as a magic 8 ball]_
  ![A Crystal Ball on a table.](https://files.catbox.moe/gybx2q.png)
- **The Scrying Orb** **[works as a coin flip]**
  ![A smaller, green Crystal Ball on a shelf.](https://files.catbox.moe/k91s7u.png)
- **New Paintings "Pondering" , "Pondering Through The Eyes of a Dog"**
  ![Two Paintings depicting a wizard looking upon his Crystal Ball, and a 2 Colour version of the previous painting.](https://files.catbox.moe/jf4ffj.png)
- **The Fushigi** _[its a weapon! it can break windows too :3]_
  ![A Fushigi on a shelf](https://files.catbox.moe/ur54e7.png)
- **_Items arent in the creative menu yet!! please use /give to get the items_**

#   With a secret to discover.
- **???** ![A Redacted Photo](https://files.catbox.moe/l5k9ri.png)
